highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.148.0 is the first stable v4 release, built on Skia m148 and rolling up all 4.147.x previews.
highlights_body: It adds variable fonts, animated WebP encoding, color font palettes, HarfBuzz 14.2.0, and the new SKStream.GetData API. It is a breaking release — the Skia engine jump from m119 to m148 removes legacy text APIs, changes singleton lifecycle, and requires Vulkan 1.1 for GPU contexts. Review the breaking changes below before upgrading from 3.x.

breaking.title: SKPaint text and font members are now compile errors
breaking.body: The text/font state (Typeface, TextSize, TextAlign, etc.) that was deprecated on SKPaint in v3 is now a compile error. Move those properties onto SKFont. See the API diff for the full list of removed members.

breaking.title: new SKFont() typeface is SKTypeface.Empty, not a lazy default
breaking.body: Upstream m132 removed lazy default-typeface resolution. new SKFont().Typeface is now SKTypeface.Empty (0 glyphs), so MeasureText returns 0 and nothing renders. Construct with an explicit typeface: new SKFont(SKTypeface.Default). Detect 'no typeface set' with font.Typeface.IsEmpty instead of == null.

breaking.title: new SKPaint().Typeface returns SKTypeface.Default, not null
breaking.body: SKPaint now seeds a default font, so new SKPaint().Typeface is never null. Code that used paint.Typeface == null to detect 'no typeface set' must switch to paint.Typeface.IsEmpty.

breaking.title: SKTypeface.FromFamilyName returns Default instead of null for unknown families on Android
breaking.body: All platforms now return SKTypeface.Default for an unknown family. For strict null semantics use SKFontManager.Default.MatchFamily(name) — it still returns null on no match.

breaking.title: SKTypeface.Default resolves through the font manager
breaking.body: sk_typeface_ref_default() was removed upstream. Default resolution now goes through the font manager. SKTypeface.Default is guaranteed non-null on every platform; Android API 36+ falls back to SKTypeface.Empty instead of crashing.

breaking.title: SKStream.Move(long) now throws OverflowException for out-of-range offsets
breaking.body: The native offset is 32-bit. The Move(long) overload previously silently truncated; it now does a checked cast and is marked [Obsolete]. Call Move(int) and clamp the value yourself.

breaking.title: GRContext.CreateVulkan aborts the process instead of returning null on Vulkan 1.0
breaking.body: Skia m139+ requires Vulkan 1.1 and calls SK_ABORT (not an exception) for 1.0 instances. Set VkApplicationInfo.apiVersion = VK_API_VERSION_1_1 and GRVkBackendContext.MaxAPIVersion = VK_API_VERSION_1_1. Hardware that only supports Vulkan 1.0 must switch to raster or another GPU backend.

breaking.title: GRVkBackendContextNative — five fields removed
breaking.body: fMinAPIVersion, fInstanceVersion, fExtensions, fFeatures, and fOwnsInstanceAndDevice were dropped from the interop struct. Delete those assignments. Use fVkExtensions instead of fExtensions and fDeviceFeatures/fDeviceFeatures2 instead of fFeatures.

breaking.title: GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo gains a Components field and loses value-equality
breaking.body: A new GRVkYcbcrComponents field was added, changing the struct layout. The type was also renamed from GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo to GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo and IEquatable<T> removed. Update struct construction to include the Components field.

breaking.title: SKNativeObject.IgnorePublicDispose setter removed
breaking.body: The protected setter for IgnorePublicDispose was removed. Subclasses that assigned it must switch to the constructor parameter or a private backing field.

bullets.lead: Skia updated through milestones m132, m147, and m148
bullets.detail: The bundled engine advances from m119 (3.x) to m148, with intermediate milestones m132 and m147 cherry-picked first, plus multiple upstream stability fix syncs from m147.
SKTypeface and SKFont now expose axis descriptors and variation coordinates, enabling applications to drive variable-font axes at runtime.
New SKWebpEncoder APIs support encoding multi-frame animated WebP files from a sequence of bitmaps.

bullets.lead: Color font palette support and improved variable font robustness
bullets.detail: Color fonts with CPAL/COLR tables can now be queried for their palette entries, and variable font handling was made more robust against malformed axis data.
A new GetData() method converts a seekable stream to SKData without copying the buffer through managed code.
Both draw calls now accept an SKSamplingOptions argument, enabling consumers to control the sampling filter when compositing surfaces.

bullets.lead: Missing API wrappers added and naming violations fixed
bullets.detail: Several missing C# wrappers were added and a set of naming convention violations across the public surface were corrected.
The lifecycle of shared/singleton SKObject instances was overhauled to fix a class of use-after-free bugs triggered by GC finalization order.

bullets.lead: SKPixmap/SKBitmap GetPixelSpan stride and axis offset fixed
bullets.detail: GetPixelSpan now uses RowBytes for stride instead of Width, and the per-pixel overload used Height instead of Width for the x-axis offset — both are corrected.
If SKPathBuilder was finalized before SKPath the destructor could access freed memory. The object graph ordering is now respected.

bullets.lead: Android SKGLView rendering after tab switch in MAUI TabBar fixed
bullets.detail: SKGLView failed to re-render after the user switched tabs in a MAUI TabBar on Android. The EGL context is now correctly re-attached on resume.

bullets.lead: Default typeface resolution moved to the managed layer
bullets.detail: Platform-specific default typeface lookup was moved from the native shim into the managed layer, fixing crashes on Android API 36+ where the native path could return null.
A missing WinUI projection DLL was preventing SkiaSharp from loading on .NET 9 WinUI projects.
Library TFMs now use versioned platform identifiers (e.g. ios26.0) while app TFMs use the unversioned form, matching the .NET SDK expectations.

bullets.lead: native-compat gate moved to SkiaApi constructor
bullets.detail: The check that verifies the loaded native library is compatible was moved from a module initializer to the SkiaApi static constructor, fixing a class of startup-order issues.
Native binaries for Linux Bionic (Android NDK sysroot libc) are now shipped, enabling SkiaSharp to run in Android-hosted Linux processes.

bullets.lead: Tizen gains x64 and arm64 native build support
bullets.detail: The Tizen native build now produces x64 and arm64 artifacts in addition to the existing armel target.

bullets.lead: WASM pre-.NET 8 Emscripten native builds dropped
bullets.detail: Native WASM builds for Emscripten versions targeting runtimes before .NET 8 have been removed; .NET 8 and later are the only supported WASM targets.

bullets.lead: C# 13 support on legacy TFMs via PolySharp
bullets.detail: PolySharp is now used to backport C# 13 language features to older target frameworks, enabling the binding to use modern language features without raising the minimum TFM.
The binding code generator was updated to CppAst 0.21.4 and its cross-platform compatibility was fixed so it runs on Linux CI agents.
Bundled native dependencies updated: FreeType 2.14.3, HarfBuzz 14.2.0, libexpat 2.7.5 / 2.8.1, libjpeg-turbo 3.1.4.1, libpng 1.6.58, zlib 1.3.2.1-motley, and expat 2.8.1.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Drove the Skia milestone bumps to m132 and m147, added variable font support, fixed the SKPath finalizer crash, overhauled the singleton lifecycle, promoted the legacy SKPaint text APIs to errors, and maintained the Uno Platform sample gallery throughout the preview cycle
contributor_summaries.4Darmygeometry: Added Linux Bionic native assets support and contributed the PolySharp integration for C# 13 support on legacy TFMs
contributor_summaries.ebariche: Reduced the SkiaFiddle WASM application bundle size by approximately 60% through asset and dependency trimming
contributor_summaries.sasakrsmanovic: Updated the Uno Platform documentation link and project description in the README
contributor_summaries.SimonvBez: Fixed SKGLView not rendering after a tab switch in a MAUI TabBar on Android

preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 opened the v4 line with the Skia m132 engine bump, variable fonts, color font palettes, SKSamplingOptions on draw calls, Linux Bionic support, Tizen x64/arm64, and the initial round of dependency security refreshes.
preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.2.1: Preview 2 added animated WebP encoding, SKStream.GetData, the SKPath finalizer fix, Apple TFM corrections, and the Uno Platform WebAssembly gallery.
preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.3.1: Preview 3 landed HarfBuzz 14.2.0, the HBColor struct, remaining API wrapper additions, the WASM pre-.NET 8 build drop, and the libjpeg-turbo security refresh.
preview_summaries.v4.148.0-rc.1.2: RC 1 advanced the engine to Skia m148, overhauled the singleton lifecycle, promoted legacy SKPaint text APIs to errors, fixed GetPixelSpan stride, corrected the WinUI .NET 9 DLL lookup, and moved the native-compat gate.

harfbuzz_summary: Ships HarfBuzz 14.2.0 with the new HBColor struct for proper hb_color_t representation, and adds variable-font shaping support.
